description: Truth, binary conjunction, binary disjunction, and biconditional in infinitary syntax have their classical truth conditions under every assignment.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.realize_abbreviations.{u, v, w, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  [Finite α] {n : ℕ} {M : Type z} [L.Structure M] (φ ψ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula L α n)
  (a : α → M) (b : Fin n → M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula.top a b ∧
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize (φ.and ψ) a b ↔
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize φ a b ∧
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize ψ a b) ∧
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize (φ.or ψ) a b ↔
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize φ a b ∨
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize ψ a b) ∧
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize (φ.iff ψ) a b ↔
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize φ a b ↔
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize ψ a b))
